description: This file defines the EducationAPI class which provides CRUD operations for managing education records via a RESTful API in an HRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting education entities, along with validation rules and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EducationAPI
classes.description: Provides REST API endpoints for CRUD operations on Education entities, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting education records with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single education record by its ID.

methods.name: getEducationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EducationService instance.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches a list of education records with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Assigns the name from request to the Education entity and saves it.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing education record specified by ID.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Constructs validation rules for the name parameter, including string type, length, and uniqueness.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more education records by their IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing records, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a new education record.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating an existing record, including handling of unique property validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for deleting education records.
